title: Digital code source
description: Time-domain sequence of nonnegative integer codes. Connect to a code-to-voltage DAC with sufficient resolution. No source noise is invented.

params.name: values
params.description: Comma-separated samples held for sps steps; final value is held until run end.

params.name: rate
params.description: Symbol rate. fs = rate × 10^9 × sps. Set all connected sources to the same fs.

params.name: kind
params.description: Fixed port type for this source definition.
